# Bootstrap stylesheet

`bootstrap.min.css` is the unmodified Bootstrap **5.3.3** distribution stylesheet,
downloaded from the official `twbs/bootstrap` tagged source. Its MIT license is
preserved in [LICENSE](LICENSE).

- Source: <https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/blob/v5.3.3/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css>
- SHA-256: `3c8f27e6009ccfd710a905e6dcf12d0ee3c6f2ac7da05b0572d3e0d12e736fc8`
- Its SHA-384 matches the integrity value of the preserved gallery's stylesheet.

The new layout uses this local stylesheet and native JavaScript. It needs no CDN,
external font, Bootstrap JavaScript bundle, account, or package installation.
